record.question: The tenure of every Panchayat in India is five years from:
options: the scheduled date of its first meeting
the date of notification of the election
the date of declaration of election results
the date of oath of office by members
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation:
Article 243E(1) sets a Panchayat’s normal term at five years from the date appointed for its first meeting, unless it is sooner dissolved under law. The trigger is therefore the first-meeting date, not election notification, result declaration, or members’ oath. The article also requires a fresh election before expiry, or within six months of an early dissolution, subject to its stated exception.

Reference: https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/08/cb1b190ea633a1746368ed1fac35fb30.pdf
